units.length: cm unless *_D (cup diameters) or *_T/*_M (frame coords, D)

impact_track.note: lowest stream (else pitcher) point mapped to the surface; the stream foot while it lands on crema, approximate when it lands on white; NaN = no occluder

frame_convention.T: frames.npz / targets/<name>.npz: arrays [iy, ix], x=(ix+0.5)/M-0.5, y=(iy+0.5)/M-0.5 [cup diameters]; pattern axis y, pours start on the B side (y<0), cut exits at +y; image->T as targets.warp (e_x = major axis to image-left, e_y = (e_x[1], -e_x[0])), then rotation targets.FRAMES[name]['rot']; mirror image of the physical top view
frame_convention.M: pitcher.Move / solver Inlet / solver arrays c[iy, ix]: right-handed top view, spout toward -y (Barista yaw=-pi/2), pitcher handle at +y; V0.5 pours start at +y and cut toward -y
frame_convention.T_to_M: (x, y)_M = (x, -y)_T ; solver field to T: c_M[::-1, :]
frame_convention.stage_positions: stage scripts give p0/p1 in the M frame (cup diameters)
